# Codebase truth map — every module, every flow, every degree of freedom

**Date: 2026-06-15** — generated by an Explore agent reading every
module front-to-back. This is the document the founder asked for: read
it once and you know what exists, what each piece does, where its
data comes from and goes to, and whether it's been tested.

> **Read this BEFORE the [Profitability Doctrine](./PROFITABILITY_DOCTRINE.md).**
> The map tells you what we have. The doctrine tells you what to do
> with it.

---

## Sentinel (45 modules total — 35 base + 10 sub-package)

### Core trading loop (15 modules)

| Module | Job | In → Out | Key symbols | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **greeks.py** | Black-Scholes pricing + IV bisection. Delta/gamma/theta/vega from live premiums. | premium/spot/strike/expiry → GreeksView, IV | `greeks()`, `implied_vol()`, `bs_price()` | 6 |
| **moneyness.py** | Expiry-independent option identity (ATM-relative offset). Survives rollover. | spot/strike/option_type → MoneynessKey | `MoneynessKey`, `moneyness_key()` | 4 |
| **shadow_ledger.py** | Append-only JSONL lab record. 5 blocks: identity/context/hypothesis/journey/judgment. The root of truth. | MarketSnapshot + outcome → file:journal/ledger_<date>.jsonl | `ShadowLedger.write()`, `new_event()` | 6 |
| **orchestration.py** | Signal router. Trust tiers SHADOW→LOGGED→TRUSTED→EXECUTION. Only EXECUTION reaches orders. | Signal → routed tally + ceiling enforcement | `Orchestrator`, `Tier`, `Signal` | 5 |
| **profit_lock.py** | Ratcheting day-profit floor. Ratio or fixed-buffer modes. Fires on drawdown past buffer. | P&L + peak → ProfitLockState + fire | `ProfitLock.update()`, `ProfitLockState` | 4 |
| **portfolio.py** | Enriched position view: Greeks, pairs, scenario repricing, breakeven curves. | raw positions/quotes/spot → PositionView, PairView | `PortfolioState.refresh()` | 5 |
| **trails.py** | Tick-driven trailing-stop engine + portfolio profit guard. Journal-backed crash recovery. | symbol/LTP/cushion → Trail state + exit signals | `TrailEngine.arm()`, `.on_tick()` | 7 |
| **kite_client.py** | Zerodha REST wrapper. Rate-limited, dry-run-safe, demo-able. | API creds → Quote/positions/funds/orders | `KiteAccount`, `RateLimiter`, `DemoAccount` | 8 |
| **scientists.py** | 6 candidate generators (the "wizards"). Each emits validated hypotheses at SHADOW tier. | MarketSnapshot → LedgerEvent hypotheses | `Scientist`, `ContractLive`, `MarketSnapshot` | 5 |
| **curator.py** | Post-hoc ledger judge. Finds biases, grades by sample size, fills JUDGMENT block. | ledger rows → Finding + CuratorReport | `Curator.judge()`, `Finding` | 6 |
| **calibration.py** | Curator findings → KNOB deltas. Re-runs stored journeys; only accepts if expectancy improves. | findings + history → Knobs + CalibrationResult | `CalibrationEngine.apply()`, `Knobs` | 4 |
| **scenario_engine.py** | Honest what-if repricing at chosen spot moves. Risk waterfall: delta/gamma/theta/vega. | entry/spot/move/time → expected premium + P&L | `evaluate()`, `ScenarioInput` | 5 |
| **leakage_guard.py** | Metric-jump alarm: CLEAN / EARNED / SUSPICIOUS. AUC jump × expectancy delta. | score + flag → LeakageVerdict | `LeakageGuard.check()` | 3 |
| **institutional.py** | Ground-anchored frameworks: SVI smile, CF VaR, vol cone, Crux scores. | strikes/IVs/legs → SVIParams + VaR + exposure | `fit_svi_slice()`, `portfolio_greek_exposures()` | 7 |
| **advisor.py** | 5 rules (R1–R5) + dip recommender + suggestion ledger with EWMA hit-rate feedback. | portfolio → Suggestion + rule_hit_rate | `Maximizer.run()`, `Suggestion` | 5 |

### Live / research spine (12 modules)

| Module | Job | In → Out | Key symbols | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **live_publisher.py** | In-memory pub/sub bus. Last-write-wins per (asset, model). Bounded history. | ModelSignal → ModelSignal + history deque | `LivePublisher`, `ModelSignal` | 4 |
| **live_models.py** | 6 honest stubs: reaction, proximity, liquidity, quality, post-reaction, manipulation. | Tick history → ModelSignal or None | `ReactionModel`, `ProximityModel`, `Tick` | 4 |
| **live_equity.py** | NIFTY top-10 constituent board + move-quality verdict. | {symbol:ltp} → StockTick + board snapshot | `ConstituentBoard.tick()`, `StockTick` | 3 |
| **liqpool_bridge.py** | Load research artifacts into MarketSnapshot context. Includes `LiveSignalsTail` for JSONL polling. | flywheel artifacts → ResearchContextPack | `ResearchContextPack`, `LiveSignalsTail` | 2 |
| **ledger_export.py** | Live→research adapter: Sentinel ledger → DecisionEvent JSONL. Idempotent. | ledger → file:export/sentinel_live/decision_events.jsonl | `DecisionEvent`, `export_ledger()` | 2 |
| **premium_tracker.py** | Per-symbol LTP history + velocity/peak/trough. Thread-safe bounded deques. | LTP → PremiumSeries + velocity | `PremiumTracker.on_quote()`, `PremiumSeries` | 3 |
| **monte_carlo.py** | Light 1k-path GBM. Δ + 0.5·Γ·move² approx. 3 horizons: P(profit/target/stop). | entry/greeks/horizon → HorizonResult | `simulate()`, `LegPayoff` | 4 |
| **crux_signal.py** | Fusion: all signals + tilt + intention → ONE of 7 verdicts. Shows contradicting signal. | bus state + tilt → CruxVerdict | `compose_from_state()`, `CruxVerdict` | 3 |
| **journey_audit.py** | Post-hoc 5-axis scorecard (0–100) + mistake detector. Cites behavioral literature. | LedgerEvent (complete) → JourneyScore + Mistake | `TradeQualityScorecard.score()` | 3 |
| **psychology.py** | 6 LIVE bias detectors + TiltIndex EWMA + IntentionContract + MindReport. Citations. | actions + positions + tilt → BiasEvent + ModelSignal | `TiltIndex.update()`, `RevengeTradeDetector` | 5 |
| **replay.py** | Replay past session through live cockpit at variable speed. Refuses if live + real. | journal/ledger_<date>.jsonl → ReplayProgress + signals | `ReplayController` | 2 |
| **paper.py** | Real LTP feed + simulated fills. Hypothetical P&L vs real account. | real quotes → PaperFill + paper_orders.jsonl | `PaperAccount`, `PaperFill` | 3 |

## liquidity_backtester / liqpool (50+ modules)

### Backbone research tracks (10 modules — THE CORE)

| Module | Job | In → Out | Key symbols | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **multi_asset.py** | Cross-asset unified ML training. Per-asset walk-forward + unified models on combined data. | OHLCV per asset → MultiAssetReport | `run_multi_asset()`, `AssetData` | 3 |
| **walkforward.py** | Expanding-window CV. Chronological folds, no leakage. Wilson CIs + overfit gap. | Config + pools + OHLCV → WalkForwardReport | `walk_forward()`, `FoldResult` | 5 |
| **ml_model.py** | LightGBM + isotonic. Small trees, bucket-level recalibration. | features + labels → PoolRespectModel | `PoolRespectModel.predict()` | 6 |
| **policy_model.py** | Phase 3D: executable policy-outcome classifier. Research-only; gates not live. | policy labels DF → PolicyOutcomeModelSuite | `policy_feature_frame()` | 2 |
| **timing.py** | Direction + multi-horizon proximity models (12/25/78 bars for MIS). Two LightGBM heads. | Snapshots → DirectionModel + ProximityModel | `generate_snapshots()`, `StateFeaturizer` | 6 |
| **feature_store.py** | Partitioned parquet for memory-safe multi-asset training. | snapshots → file:store/*.parquet | `FeatureStore.write()`, `PROXIMITY_HORIZONS` | 3 |
| **reaction_model.py** | Phase 3 post-touch: reaction vs reclaim vs break continuation. | event rows → ReactionModelSuite | `reaction_feature_frame()` | 2 |
| **sectors.py** | NSE sector map + sector aggregates. 10 sectors. | symbol → sector label + analytics | `sector_of()`, `SECTOR_MAP` | 2 |
| **leakage_audit.py** | Causal-assumption checker. No pre-consumption, label ≥ availability, embargo consistency. | pool + result + config → LeakageIssue[] | `audit_leakage()` | 3 |
| **execution_backtest.py** | Simulate execution: stop/target/slippage/Zerodha costs. The honest P&L source. | pool + mode + costs → ExecutionTrade | `simulate_execution()`, `ExecutionTrade` | 4 |

## Test coverage summary

| Repo | Modules | Test files | Battle-tested | Stubs / sparse |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel | 45 | 24 | orchestration, shadow_ledger, curator, trail, kite_client, server | help_text (0), config (1), liqpool_bridge (2), replay (2), paper (3), byok (2) |
| liqpool | 50+ | 76+ | walkforward, ml_model, timing, pools, tester, execution_backtest, live_feed | cli (0), drift (1), reaction_model (2), policy_model (2) |

**Critical gaps**:
1. `sentinel/help_text.py` (0 tests) — onboarding contract untested
2. `sentinel/config.py` (1 test) — env-driven handling barely covered
3. `liqpool/cli.py` (0 tests) — CLI entry point untested
4. Cross-repo integration — minimal beyond the 33 cross-codebase tests

## Degrees of freedom (where the knobs are)

### Sentinel
- **`Knobs`** (8 fields): `target_distance_mult`, `stop_distance_mult`, `entry_threshold`, `holding_time_min`, `confidence_haircut`, `partial_booking_ratio`, `trail_aggressiveness`, `strike_preference`
- **`ProfitLockState`** (6 fields): mode (ratio/buffer), `lock_ratio`, `give_back_buffer`, `activation_floor`
- **`AuthContext.plan`**: RETAIL / PRO / QUANT / FOUNDER — gates 20+ features
- **`Tier`**: SHADOW / LOGGED / TRUSTED / EXECUTION — controls signal routing
- **6 scientists** (can be extended)
- **5 advisor rules** (R1–R5) — independent hit-rate feedback

### liqpool
- **`Config`** (30+ fields): detector params, ML hyperparams, test horizon, costs
- **Walk-forward fold strategy**: expanding window, test-size, embargo days
- **3 proximity horizons** (12/25/78 bars for MIS) + 78-bar direction
- **Stratification**: sector × TF × distance — 10×5×5 grid
- **9 calibrators** (conformal, EB, temperature, isotonic, etc.)
- **7 flywheel organs** — each independently trainable or unfit

### Cross-repo
- **`ResearchContextPack`** (8 fields): direction_prob, proximity_h12/36/60, sector_regime, avoid_flags, model_health, key_zones
- **Live inference bundle**: configurable head selection (direction/proximity/quality)
- **`KIND_MAP`** (6 transformations): Sentinel kind → research event type

## What's missing for the new mission (profitability)

| Link in profit chain | What we have | What we still need |
|---|---|---|
| Edge identification | Hypothesis library skeleton | 10 hypotheses coded against `HypothesisHarness` |
| Edge validation | `walkforward.py` + `leakage_audit.py` | Run them on real warehouse data |
| Edge implementation | Full trust spine + paper account | Wire one validated hypothesis to EXECUTION via the orchestrator |
| Edge management | `profit_lock.py` + `Knobs` | Kelly-fractional sizer module |
| Edge maintenance | `curator.py` + `calibration.py` | Decay-detection thresholds tied to live P&L attribution |
| Compounding | `profit_lock.py` (defensive only) | Bankroll growth function with weekly review trigger |

---

**Bottom line**: we have a kitchen with every imaginable tool, lit by
beautiful lights, with a head chef who understands behavioral
discipline. We have no proven recipes yet. The pivot is to test
recipes systematically. The harness exists; the hypotheses don't yet.
That's the next two weeks' work.
